footer.intro: Checked on {checkedOn} against the latest releases, each in its default quick-start setup ([probes and raw results](https://github.com/DaanRosendal/limmat/blob/master/benchmarks/compare/README.md)). Wrong or out of date? Open an issue or pull request.
metrics: Rules: safe means no script ran and no unsafe link scheme (such as `javascript:`) was kept. The markers mark is a check for none, a warning for 1 to 3 leaked constructs, and a cross for more. CommonMark is tag structure and text on the {cmTotal} examples of spec 0.31.2, approximate, with a check over 80 percent, a warning from 50 to 80, and a cross below. Dependencies are all packages installed below the library, not counting React. Bold means more than a year ago.

details.markersNote: marked and react-markdown are not streaming renderers.
details.limmatImages: limmat can turn this off with `images: false`.

markersNotes.streamdown: Streamdown's leaks are brief, a lone opening marker, a half-typed table, or a link's brackets, with its remend option on as in its README.
